citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
The facility is not adequately cleaning the housing facilities. In both sheltered housing buildings for the dogs there was an
excessive buildup of dust and animal hair caught in the metal bars of the top 1/3rd of the gate at the front of the primary
enclosures. Dust and animal hair were also observed accumulated on the tops of the primary enclosures and the food
receptacle lids. Multiple ventilation fans were observed with an excess accumulation of dust in the metal wire covers.
Failure to adequately clean the premises can lead to illness, transmission of diseases, create a fire hazard, and attract
unwanted pests. The facility must ensure that the premises, including housing facilities are kept clean and in good repair
to protect the animals from injury to facilitate the prescribed husbandry practices set forth in this subpart.
Correct by: July 2, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
